This '''Techno Union facility''' was a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] on [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]]. It was used by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] to [[Mutant|mutate]] male [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] warriors by submerging them in [[3L41UH7 serum]].<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> These mutated warriors had a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] grafted to their arm and some form of control device on their chest. These experiments were based around a [[siphon generator]] that drained thermal energy from the surrounding area, resulting in the endless winter experienced all over the planet. The base was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the Nelvaanian's prophesied [[Holt Kazed]], who liberated the Nelvaanian warriors in the [[Battle of Nelvaan]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
